moa: Orally administered live biotherapeutic (purified Firmicutes spores) that restores the gut microbiome

approval_evidence.quote: STN: 125757 Proper Name: fecal microbiota spores, live-brpk Tradename: VOWST Manufacturer: Seres Therapeutics, Inc. ... April 26, 2023 Approval Letter - VOWST

series_start_reason: 2023Q2 is the first quarter in which Seres printed a VOWST net sales figure (the first partial quarter after the early June 2023 launch).
series_end_reason: Seres sold the VOWST business to Nestle Health Science on 2024-09-30 (Q3 2024 10-Q, Note 3: the VOWST Business is reported as discontinued operations). The Q2 2024 release is the last Seres document printing a quarterly VOWST net sales figure; the Q3 2024 10-Q prints none (its only 'net sales' mentions are milestone thresholds and the profit-share definition).
notes: Sales are VOWST net sales recorded by Nestle Health Science and reported in Seres' releases; Q1 and Q2 2024 are printed as approximately. Q4 2023 release prints 19.6 since launch, equal to 1.6 + 7.6 + 10.4. The US/Canada profit-share definition in the Q3 2024 10-Q is a post-sale term, not part of this series; no table in the cited releases is a geographic disaggregation, so geography is the U.S. launch market as stated in the Q2 2023 release ('commercially available in the U.S.').
